race.comment: WHY WAIT (11) Anders filly resuming for her second prep. Led all the way from the inside gate on debut to score a sharp win over 1000m at Grafton last March. Primed with the two good trials and can continue where she left off from the sticky gate. ALLEZE (1) raced without luck at his two runs back and gets map favours today from the inside draw. Caught the eye late from the wide gate with a tidy fifth over 1200m at Coffs Harbour. Cherry-ripe now and looks a real threat. GOT THE SMARTS (7) mixing her form this time in and kept fresh for this. Failed to backup with the weight increase when a battling fifth over 1200m at Grafton. Can sit off the good speed and savage the line. PERMISSION GRANTED (2) capable on his day and comes back in trip with the key jockey change. Failed to run the 1430m out when a tiring ninth at Grafton. Can hold a position and take a hand in the finish.
